families.name: Volume-based alternative under review
families.prior_specification: Signed M1 candle-volume Q proxy, SPECIFIED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
families.finding: The prior Q proxy lacks a primary source for that exact trading rule; it must not be described as actual aggressor flow or an established profitable strategy.
families.possible_known_replacement: Chaikin Money Flow; replacing Q would require a new preregistered version before any score
families.limitation: CMF is also a price-volume proxy. Creator documentation explicitly distinguishes it from directly monitored institutional order flow. No replacement is silently adopted.

selection_rule: No strategy added because of observed performance. At most five alternatives; any change to S5 is registered before outcome tests. All variants and abandoned specifications remain in the ledger.
